Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: No national digital identity system exists. Biometric civil servant registration exists for payroll control but functions as a silo. No integration with a data exchange layer.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: No law governing cross-government data sharing enacted. Cybercrimes and Computer Misuse Bill 2024 passed by National Legislative Assembly but not yet signed. No data protection law. The 2019 e-Government system relies on a private contractor's National e-Government Framework rather than legislation.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: A National e-Government Framework exists (contractor-developed since 2019) and digital transformation is mentioned in national economic conference papers (Sept 2023). No comprehensive dedicated interoperability strategy found. Data exchange is mentioned in broader digital economy aspirations but not a standalone strategy.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No unified national data exchange system established. The Ministry of ICT (MICT&PS) introduced an e-Government system in 2019 via private contractor; an Inter-Bank Payment and Settlement System was launched Oct 2025 by the Bank of South Sudan; but no cross-government interoperability platform exists. De facto digital systems operate in silos. Status = Planned at the national cross-government level.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Digital services primarily urban-centric (Juba). Low digital literacy, high data costs, and infrastructure gaps severely limit accessibility. UN EGDI ranks South Sudan 192nd out of 193 (score 0.1191) in 2024.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: No data protection legislation enacted. Draft Data Protection Bill (2020) developed by CSOs not yet approved. Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Bill passed by legislature in 2025 awaiting presidential assent. No data localization or foreign access restrictions in force.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Digital systems concentrated in Juba. Border regions and rural counties remain digitally excluded. All existing platforms are national-level only with very limited sub-national reach.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Infrastructure primarily urban (Juba-centric). Outside Juba, network coverage is intermittent; digital services degrade sharply. Hundreds of thousands displaced to urban centres. Rural counties digitally excluded.
